data.one_liner: A lightweight architecture helper for Flutter projects using Provider and BLoC.
data.what_it_does: Provides a DependencyInjectorHelper widget to inject mappers, services, repositories, and global BLoCs down the widget tree in a structured layered architecture.
use_when: You want a structured layered architecture using Provider and BLoC.
You want to organize global dependencies like mappers, services, and repositories cleanly.
avoid_when: You are not using Provider or Flutter BLoC in your project.
You prefer a different state management library like Riverpod.
strengths: Simplifies wiring up layered architectures with BLoC and Provider.
Makes testing easier by allowing mock dependency injection via DependencyInjectorHelper.
weaknesses: Tight coupling to Provider and Flutter BLoC.
Limited feature set beyond basic dependency organization.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want pure state and dependency injection without a specialized architecture wrapper.
